Dp.bar_b_note: The standing Stormcapra-style ram matches the owner style bar with readable fleece, horns and blue accents, but on a flat grey stage with no world light it cannot carry Palworld/Valheim finish; A's faint frames twist into an unreadable knot (body appears rolled with legs and horns crossed), while B's faint reads as a collapse but the legs vanish into a fleece blob with horns lying off the body.

Ql.bar_b_note: B's larger wrapped recipe lines and gold ingredient rows fix legibility, but only three oversized list rows fit, the Craft/Leave hints are small white text with tiny keyboard-style glyphs rather than teal controller prompts, and the dark rainy world behind is murky and flat; A's tiny truncated sub-lines ('3 St...') and grey 'Craft: A / Enter' hint sink it.

It.bar_b_note: A's boar has naturalistic mottled fur close to the style bar but a noisy gold-speckle pattern and a faint-mid frame where the body floats above its shadow; B reads as a smooth terracotta piggy-bank with pasted green moss blobs, off the naturalistic style bar; both stand only about trainer height, not taller.

Dh.bar_b_note: The craft panel is clean and on-direction (blue-grey translucent panel, pale borders, gold/orange ingredient rows, teal Leave hint) with every recipe and material line fitting, but list sub-text is small for a 7-inch screen, the greyed 'Missing materials' button is low-contrast, and the meadow behind is dim and blocky.

Fc.bar_b_note: Same result as Dh: the panel is legible, with no clipped recipe or material lines and good gold/teal hierarchy, but the small list sub-text, the low-contrast disabled craft button and the murky, low-detail meadow backdrop keep it below shipping finish.

Ur.bar_b_note: The Grandpa Elias villager matches the dialogue-board identity (white hair and beard, green vest and scarf, warm earthy palette) with a readable face and clear full-body silhouette, but he is rendered in a soft cartoon-film style with oversized eyes, a step away from the naturalistic stylised-realism direction, and is lit flat against a black void with no world atmosphere.

top_changes.change: Bring creature faint/hit animations to grounded, readable poses: keep legs and horns attached and visible, keep the body on its contact shadow (It A faint mid floats), and avoid the rolled or knotted end frames seen in Dp A; also scale creatures so they clearly stand taller than the 1.80 m trainer (It).
Re-texture the boar (It B) with naturalistic fur and moss material in place of the smooth clay-and-blob shader, aiming for the owner style bar's fur/plate detail.

Finish the craft UI pass: use compact rows so 5-6 recipes fit with wrapped sub-lines (B's text size, A's density), add teal controller-first Craft/Leave prompts with a strong primary button, and raise list sub-text size and the contrast of the disabled button.
